Your Nostr history deserves a backup too.

Account Archive in Nostr WoT lets you collect your events from relays, download a copy and import it again. You can also copy eligible events to another relay while keeping the originals.

Lesson 13 walks through the process in under two minutes. Downloads contain signed events without a file password. Keep a separate backup of your keys.
